quiz.intro.2: Good. Don't be afraid. You are about to wake up in a world that is not yours.
quiz.intro.3: First, answer me honestly. Your answers will tell who you really are.
quiz.q.lantern: You are walking at night and your lantern suddenly goes out. What do you do?
quiz.q.lantern.a1: I keep going in the dark.
quiz.q.lantern.a3: I laugh. Someone must be playing a trick on me.
quiz.q.mask: Someone offers you a mask that gives you anyone's face. Do you take it?
quiz.q.mask.a1: Yes, and I'll use it to play pranks.
quiz.q.mask.a2: No. I like being who I am.
quiz.q.mask.a3: Yes, so nobody ever recognises me again.
quiz.q.friend: Someone you love is crying and won't tell you why. What do you do?
quiz.q.friend.a1: I sit beside them without a word.
quiz.q.friend.a2: I tease them until they laugh.
quiz.q.friend.a3: I go after whoever hurt them.
quiz.q.mirror: In an old mirror, your reflection moves a second late. What do you do?
quiz.q.mirror.a1: I stick my tongue out at it and see what it does.
quiz.q.mirror.a2: I back away slowly and never look again.
quiz.q.mirror.a3: I wave. Maybe it wants to play.
quiz.q.storm: A storm traps you in a cabin with strangers. What do you do?
quiz.q.storm.a1: I set up shifts to watch the door.
quiz.q.storm.a2: I tell ghost stories to liven up the night.
quiz.q.storm.a3: I find a quiet corner and wait it out.
quiz.q.keepsake: You find something that belonged to someone who is gone. What do you do?
quiz.q.keepsake.a1: I keep it and carry it with me always.
quiz.q.keepsake.a2: I leave it where it was. It isn't mine.
quiz.q.keepsake.a3: I try it on to see how it looks on me.
quiz.q.voice: Someone calls your name from a dark corridor. What do you do?
quiz.q.voice.a2: I pretend I didn't hear anything.
quiz.q.voice.a3: I walk towards the voice. I'm curious.
quiz.q.wish: If you could make one wish tonight, what would it be?
quiz.q.wish.a1: That nobody would ever feel alone again.
quiz.q.wish.a3: That the world were a little stranger.
quiz.nature.brave.text: You don't run when things turn ugly. You stand your ground, even with shaking legs.
quiz.nature.calm.text: You listen before you act. Your calm is a small light that guides others through the dark.
quiz.nature.hardy.text: You carry whatever must be carried without complaint. What you lose, you keep with you.
quiz.nature.jolly.text: Even on the blackest night you find something to laugh about, and your laughter spreads.
quiz.nature.lonely.text: You hide from others, but deep down you only want someone to love you as you are.
quiz.nature.quirky.text: Nobody ever knows what you'll do next. Not even you. And you love it.
quiz.nature.sassy.text: You say what you think and poke fun at anyone who takes things too seriously.
quiz.nature.timid.text: You startle easily, but you see danger before anyone else.

passive.disguise.description: The first hit you take in each room deals no damage and breaks the disguise.
move.fury-swipes.description: Five quick scratches in front of you; the last one hits hard. Normal: barely hurts Ghosts (Gastly, Aegislash).
move.feint-attack.description: A swift feint: you dart through the enemy and end up behind it, facing it. Fast and free.
move.night-daze.description: A dark wave around you that hits everyone. Hold to charge.
move.foul-play.description: A charged lunge; deals more damage if the enemy is attacking.
move.ember.description: A small, fast flame at range. Free.
move.astonish.description: A point-blank scare that staggers and pushes the enemy away.
move.hex.description: A slow wisp; double damage if the enemy is staggered. Hold to charge.
move.inferno.description: A big, very slow and very strong fireball. Hold to charge.
move.bone-club.description: A short bone swing that staggers hard.
move.bone-rush.description: Three bone blows while you advance; the last one hits hard.
move.bonemerang.description: You throw the bone: it flies out, comes back to you and you catch it; it hits on both passes. Hold to charge.
move.stomping-tantrum.description: A charged stomp all around; twice as strong if your previous attack missed.
move.swords-dance.description: A frenetic dance: your next 3 hits deal 50% more damage (9 s).
move.nasty-plot.description: Plots something nasty: faster and more critical hits for 5 s.
move.will-o-wisp.description: Ghostly flames: lights Flash Fire at once; your next heavy move is powered up.
move.bulk-up.description: Tenses its muscles: takes 40% less damage for 6 s.
move.dazzling-gleam.description: A flash all around you that hits everyone close.
move.shadow-force.description: A slow, brutal strike from the shadows: a wide cone in front.
move.dark-pulse.description: A sinister ring wave that clears whoever surrounds you.
move.snarl.description: A furious yell in a very wide cone; quick to throw, less power.
move.flamethrower.description: A straight blast of flame that goes through every enemy in its line.
move.heat-wave.description: A scorching gust in a wide cone in front of you.
move.earthquake.description: You shake the ground: a huge, strong ring, but slow to come out.
move.bulldoze.description: A stomp that shakes the ground around you; quick and short.
passive.illusion.description: You enter each floor disguised: sleeping enemies do not notice you until you touch them, and your first hit is critical.
passive.flash-fire.description: Fire-type attacks do not hurt you: they heal you a little and power up your next heavy move. Nobody in the Crypt attacks with Fire, so your own flames stoke it: every 4 Fire hits power up your next heavy move.
passive.battle-armor.description: While you charge or wind up a heavy move, hits from the front deal half damage.

prologue.skipHint: Hold Esc or Enter to skip
prologue.light.1: There was a time when the sun knew no shadow.
prologue.light.2: Pokémon lived in its shelter, and wanted for nothing.
prologue.hunger.1: But beneath the earth, something woke up hungry.
prologue.hunger.2: It sought neither flesh nor land. It sought the light.
prologue.dimming.1: It drank from the sun, day after day, until the sun was hollow.
prologue.dimming.2: The sky went out like an ember no one tends.
prologue.eclipse.1: And then came the Crimson Eclipse.
prologue.eclipse.2: A red ring over nothing. It has not moved since.
prologue.dungeons.1: With it, the Shadow Dungeons opened:
prologue.dungeons.2: mouths of stone that were not there the day before.
prologue.shadows.1: Many went in to find what had been lost.
prologue.shadows.2: Those who came back were no longer themselves. Only their shadows.
prologue.guardians.1: Every dungeon has its guardian, bound by an oath that no one remembers.
prologue.guardians.2: And deeper than them all, something is still devouring the light.
prologue.voice.1: …Do you hear me? Can you hear me?
dungeon.crypt.name: Crypt of the Sword King
dungeon.crypt.subtitle: Where steel still awaits its orders
dungeon.crypt.lore.1: In the depths of the crypt, the Sword King guards a sealed door.
dungeon.crypt.lore.2: No one knows whether he shields the world from what lies behind it, or what lies behind it from the world.
town.beacon.1: A cold flame burns in the stone. Whoever stokes it calls other explorers to an online room.
town.beacon.room: The flame already burns for your room. Esc opens the room menu.
town.gacha.1: Did you come to play with me? Every capsule brings someone new, and I want lots of friends.
town.shop.1: Since the Crimson Eclipse the forge will not light by itself. Bring me what you find below and I will make you stronger.
town.story.1: There was a sun that knew no shadow. Now only that red ring remains: the Crimson Eclipse.
town.story.2: With the eclipse the Shadow Dungeons opened. Those who come back are not themselves. Only their shadow.
town.story.3: Every dungeon has its guardian, bound to an oath no one remembers. The Sword King is only the first.
town.story.4: And deeper than all of them, something is still devouring the light. No one has seen its face.
town.board.title: Records on this device:
town.board.none: No records yet. Be the first to come back from the crypt!
town.exit.title: Destination

dungeon.eclipse.name: Eclipse Chasm
dungeon.eclipse.subtitle: Where the light falls and never lands
dungeon.eclipse.lore.1: Under the red ring a bottomless rift opened. What goes down it comes back as an echo.
dungeon.eclipse.lore.2: Down there the fallen guardians rise again, and the eclipse swallows every floor that lingers.
screen.eclipse.title: The eclipse caught you
screen.eclipse.text: Time is up: the dark swallowed the floor. Your mark stays on the board.

endless.entry.pure: Pure mode: you start at level 1, with no items and without the shop's upgrades. What you find below does count.

dungeon.forest.name: Misty Forest
dungeon.forest.subtitle: Where the fog is the breath of the lost
dungeon.forest.lore.1: Those lost in the fog never return: they take root, and listen.
dungeon.forest.lore.2: In the deepest clearing, a faceless archer keeps watch over a door no one has seen open.
spell.decidueye.dive: Owl Sign "Dive of the Hollow Moon"
guardian.decidueye.title: The Archer of the Fog
guardian.decidueye.pre.1: The fog has led you to the clearing. Here the paths end.
guardian.decidueye.pre.2: I have watched this door since the sun went out. No one crosses while I have an arrow left.
guardian.decidueye.post.1: My oath was a drawn bowstring. At last it rests.
guardian.decidueye.post.2: Beneath the roots, something still drinks the light. I hear it breathing in the fog.
dungeon.forest.floor.1: The mist is young here; the trees still remember names.
dungeon.forest.floor.2: Here the pumpkins laugh alone when no one walks by.
dungeon.forest.floor.3: The paths move while you sleep.
dungeon.forest.floor.4: The hollow trunk listens. Something inside learned to hate.
dungeon.forest.floor.5: Under the moss, the roots drink from those who gave up.
dungeon.forest.floor.6: Wandering lights guide those who know how to ask forgiveness.
dungeon.forest.floor.7: The mist is no longer breath: it is a choir of lost voices.
dungeon.forest.floor.8: The deepest clearing. A taut string waits in the dark.
forest.wisp.appear: A wandering light beckons between the trees.
forest.wisp.found: The light settles over a hidden cache of berries.
spell.trevenant.roots: Root Sign «Paths of the Hungry Root»
spell.trevenant.spiral: Leaf Sign «Spiral of the Weeping Wood»
spell.trevenant.grove: Grove Sign «Dance of the Thousand Branches»
spell.decidueye.mist: The Archer fades into the mist
spell.decidueye.stitch: Shadow Sign «Stitch of the Twin Shadows»
guardian.aegislash.title: The Sword King
guardian.aegislash.pre.1: I am the first of those who keep watch. No shadow passes this door.
guardian.aegislash.pre.2: Draw, little one. Let steel say who goes on.
guardian.aegislash.post.1: The oath breaks… but this was not the only door.
guardian.aegislash.post.2: Beyond, other guardians wait. And deeper still, the light keeps falling.
log.itemStolen: {thief} stole your {item}! Hit it to get it back.
dungeon.crypt.floor.1: The halls smell of wax and old iron.
dungeon.crypt.floor.2: Here rest those who swore. Some do not rest.
dungeon.crypt.floor.3: The king's treasury. Something glints, and it is not gold.
dungeon.crypt.floor.4: Fallen swords still rise as you pass.
dungeon.crypt.floor.5: The air trembles. Further down, the steel is waiting.
dungeon.crypt.floor.6: The throne room. Kneel, or draw.

world.sima.name: Eclipse Abyss
world.sealed.locked: A red seal bars the way. It will break when the guardian of {dungeon} falls.
world.sealed.missing: The abyss lets no one through. Not yet. Something down there has not finished waking.
world.npc.fisher.1: Nothing has bitten since the eclipse. Only shadows. I keep casting anyway: someone has to.
world.npc.fisher.2: The lake no longer mirrors the sky. It mirrors what lies beneath. Don't lean over too far.
world.npc.keeper.1: This hamlet lived off the lake's light. When the sun went out, the water turned black.
world.npc.keeper.2: My flame is small, but it does not go out. Those lost in the fog follow it here.
world.npc.keeper.3: Lookout Pass joins the two villages. Mind the rift: the bridge is the only thing still standing.
world.npc.keeper.4: They say that in the northern crater the eclipse is so close you can hear it. A hum, like a heart.
world.npc.oracle.1: I see a stall full of capsules and folk trying their luck under the red ring… Not yet. Soon.
world.npc.oracle.2: Beyond the lake lie lands that have no name yet. Some day the road will go on.
world.lore.knight.name: Faceless statue
world.lore.knight.1: A faceless stone knight. At its feet: "Who swore by the sword shall never let it go."
world.lore.knight.2: The inscription has changed. Now it reads: "Rest, Sword King. Your oath is over."
world.lore.knight.3: Someone has left an owl feather at its feet. It is still warm.
world.lore.sign.name: Road sign
world.lore.sign.1: West: Dusk Haven. East: Lookout Pass. North, the crypt. Do not go down alone.
world.lore.sign.2: Someone has crossed out "Do not go down alone" and written below: "One came back."
world.lore.view.name: Lookout
world.lore.view.1: From here the whole Crimson Eclipse is in sight. Every night it seems a little closer.
world.lore.view.2: To the south, the forest's fog moves as if it were breathing.
world.lore.view.3: At last you can see the bottom of the crater to the north. Something red beats down there, in time with the eclipse.
world.lore.crater.name: Burnt statue
world.lore.crater.1: A statue stares into the abyss. Its hands are burnt, as if it had tried to hold the sun.
world.lore.crater.2: Carved on the base: "The first guardian fell. The others have felt it."
world.lore.crater.3: A fresh carving, no moss on it yet: "The abyss has no bottom. Only more eclipse."
world.lore.idol.name: Lake idol
world.lore.idol.1: A moss-covered frog idol. The lake folk leave it offerings so the water stays still.
world.lore.idol.2: There is a new offering: a broken sword, its hilt turned towards the lake.
world.lore.idol.3: For an instant, the water by the idol mirrors a sun that no longer exists.
lobby.hostOnly: Only the room's host can lead the group into a dungeon.
difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.easy.hint: The game as it always was. Unlimited floor restarts.
difficulty.normal.hint: Somewhat tougher, keener enemies, the odd elite. Pays ×1.3.
difficulty.hard.hint: New attacks and longer combos, more elites, 1 restart per floor. Pays ×1.7.
difficulty.nightmare.hint: Extra spell cards and frequent elites, no restarts. Pays ×2.2.
dungeon.caves.name: Flooded Caves
dungeon.caves.subtitle: Where the drowned bell still calls its own
dungeon.caves.lore.1: Under the Black Lake sleeps a sunken shrine; its bell rings at every eclipse.
dungeon.caves.lore.2: They say an anchor with no ship keeps the deep, bound to an oath nobody remembers.
dungeon.caves.floor.1: Water drips from a sky of stone. Every drop sounds like a distant bell.
dungeon.caves.floor.2: The crystals keep the last light that fell here. Something is drinking it.
dungeon.caves.floor.3: Ship's ropes float in the pools. No ship ever came this deep.
dungeon.caves.floor.4: The water reaches your ankles. Further down, something pulls at it.
dungeon.caves.floor.5: A grotto of blue light. That lantern is not there to guide you.
dungeon.caves.floor.6: Past the lantern, the only light left is the one you bring.
dungeon.caves.floor.7: The walls weep salt. Sailors swore oaths here and never came back.
dungeon.caves.floor.8: The bell rings closer, and no current moves it.
dungeon.caves.floor.9: The water is warm, as if something huge were breathing below.
dungeon.caves.floor.10: The wreck. An anchor keeps watch over a crew that sank with its oath.
spell.lanturn.bubbles: Bubble Sign "Rings of the Silent Deep"
spell.dhelmise.undertow: Anchor Sign "Undertow of the Drowned Bell"
spell.dhelmise.riptide: Phantom Sign "Current Rising from the Wreck"
spell.dhelmise.bell: Bell Sign "Toll of the Sunken Oaths"
guardian.dhelmise.title: The Anchor of the Sunken Oaths
guardian.dhelmise.pre.1: The bell has led you to the wreck. Here the water lets no one go back.
guardian.dhelmise.pre.2: I swore to keep those who sank with me. Nobody remembers the oath now, but the anchor does.
guardian.dhelmise.post.1: The chain comes loose. At last I can go down with them.
guardian.dhelmise.post.2: Deeper than the deep, something swallows the light. The bell was ringing to warn you.
dungeon.swamp.name: Toxic Swamp
dungeon.swamp.subtitle: Where the eclipse light dripped from another sky
dungeon.swamp.lore.1: The first drop of the red light fell here. The water drank it, and turned to poison.
dungeon.swamp.lore.2: At the heart of the swamp, something not of this world floats above a tear in the sky.
dungeon.swamp.floor.1: The water does not reflect the sky. It reflects another one.
dungeon.swamp.floor.2: The bubbles burst with a sweet smell. Do not breathe deep.
dungeon.swamp.floor.3: The trees died standing, looking up.
dungeon.swamp.floor.4: The spores glow like stars that fell into the wrong sky.
dungeon.swamp.floor.5: It smells of sweet smoke. The queen of the swamp already knows you are here.
dungeon.swamp.floor.6: Past the den, the mud whispers in a tongue without words.
dungeon.swamp.floor.7: Something beats under the mire, slowly, like a stranger's heart.
dungeon.swamp.floor.8: The stones are cold and smooth, like glass fallen from above.
dungeon.swamp.floor.9: The air hums. The wound in the sky is close.
dungeon.swamp.floor.10: Beneath the wound in the sky, something waits for you, and it has no face.
world.npc.hermit.1: Croak… Do not step in the black water. It does not wet: it bites.
world.npc.hermit.2: The night the sun went out, a drop of red light fell right here. The swamp has not slept since.
world.npc.hermit.3: Something floats over the rift, at the bottom of the swamp. It is not from here. I think it is not even from this sky.
world.lore.crystal.name: Fallen crystal
world.lore.crystal.1: A cold crystal, half sunk in the mud. It hums, as if it were listening to something very far away.
world.lore.crystal.2: Inside the crystal you can see a sky that is not this one: black, starless, crossed by a breaking light.
world.lore.crystal.3: The hum has changed. Now it sounds like a door someone is pushing from the other side.
guardian.nihilego.title: «She Who Fell Through the Rift in the Sky»
guardian.nihilego.pre.1: The water holds its breath. Above the rift, something floats without weight.
guardian.nihilego.pre.2: I come from a sunless sky. There the light shattered, and its hunger reached you.
guardian.nihilego.post.1: I fade… On the other side many more still watch through the rift.
guardian.nihilego.post.2: The light you lack was not lost. Something drinks it, beyond your sky.
sima.band.crypt.name: Stratum I · Echoes of the Crypt
sima.band.crypt.subtitle: Where steel remembers the light
sima.band.crypt.lore.1: The first walls still smell of the wax of the King's candles.
sima.band.crypt.lore.2: Something comes down with you. It makes no sound. It only copies you.
sima.band.crypt.lore.3: Every step down is one candle fewer.
sima.band.crypt.lore.4: The red ring watches from above. It is still small.
sima.band.forest.name: Stratum II · Roots of the Sunken Forest
sima.band.forest.subtitle: The mist fell through the rift as well
sima.band.forest.lore.1: Roots without a tree hang from the ceiling, reaching for a sun that is not there.
sima.band.forest.lore.2: The pumpkins still sing, though no one down here listens.
sima.band.forest.lore.3: The moss glows red. It is not daylight any more.
sima.band.forest.lore.4: An owl hoots very far away, or very close. Down here it is the same.
sima.band.abyss.name: Stratum V · The Abyss beneath the Ring
sima.band.abyss.subtitle: Islands of stone over nothing, and the falling light
sima.band.abyss.lore.1: There are no walls any more. Only floating stone and the fall all around.
sima.band.abyss.lore.2: The red light rains downwards and never reaches the bottom.
sima.band.abyss.lore.3: Far off stand the towers of a kingdom that sank whole.
sima.band.abyss.lore.4: The eclipse fills half the sky. It beats.
sima.band.abyss.lore.5: Down here even time is in a hurry.
sima.log.vault.here: It smells of gold on this floor: a treasure vault, and something guards it.
sima.log.vault.opened: The chest opens! Pick an item.
sima.log.shrine.here: An eclipse altar throbs somewhere on this floor.
sima.log.shrine.accepted: The pact is sealed. The eclipse gives and the eclipse takes.
sima.log.shrine.declined: You turn your back on the altar. Its light goes out.
sima.log.monsterHouse.woke: A monster house! They all wake at once.
sima.log.crystal.here: A time crystal glows on this floor. It will not last.
sima.log.crystal.faded: The time crystal has gone out.
sima.log.merchant.here: A merchant echo waits on this floor. It takes Pokédollars.
sima.log.merchant.berry: You eat the merchant's Oran Berry.
sima.log.nest.here: Something hums between the walls: an eclipse nest.
sima.log.nest.woke: The nest wakes! Break it or it will not stop.
sima.log.nest.destroyed: The nest cracks and falls silent.
sima.log.waves.here: A room on this floor has doors that close by themselves.
sima.log.waves.start: The doors slam shut! Hold out against the waves.
sima.log.waves.cleared: The doors open. The room rewards you.
sima.log.ambush.woke: The ground cracks under your feet...
sima.log.hunter.here: Something has caught your scent. Find the stairs, fast.
sima.log.hunter.loosed: The Eclipse Hound is after you! It cannot be beaten: run.

sima.pact.blood.name: Moon Blood
sima.pact.sand.name: Stilled Sand

sima.merchant.hint: You carry {coins} P from this run. What you spend here is not paid out at the end.
sima.merchant.leaveText: The echo watches you go without a word.
sima.echo.subtitle: Floor {floor} · The shadow that came down with you
sima.echo.line.1: The eclipse gives you back a shadow shaped like {species}. Hollow and red.
sima.echo.line.2: Something has come down with you from the start: the echo of {species}, made of what you left behind.
sima.echo.line.3: The echo of {species} no longer mimics: it remembers. Every floor makes it more yours.

sima.band.caves.name: Stratum III · The Drowned Bell
sima.band.caves.subtitle: The lake's water came down here, and so did its bell
sima.band.caves.lore.1: Water runs up the walls here, towards the eclipse.
sima.band.caves.lore.2: The bell of the wreck rings below you. Or above.
sima.band.caves.lore.3: Crystals keep a light that never reached the lake.
sima.band.caves.lore.4: An anchor chain hangs into the dark and pulls at nothing.
sima.band.swamp.name: Stratum IV · The Poisoned Sky
sima.band.swamp.subtitle: Where the red light drips and turns the water sweet
sima.band.swamp.lore.1: The water does not reflect this sky. It reflects the other one.
sima.band.swamp.lore.2: The mist smells sweet. Do not breathe deep.
sima.band.swamp.lore.3: Dead trees grow downwards, towards the eclipse.
sima.band.swamp.lore.4: A tear in the sky drips here. Something is watching through it.

shrine.reflections.text: Fight a boss you have beaten again, in its own room, at the level you would have on its floor. No items, no upgrades.
shrine.gauntlets.text: Bosses back to back. HP does not come back between fights, save for a breath.
shrine.heralds.text: The Eclipse heralds you have seen, by their seed.

move.x-scissor.description: Two crossed blades in front of you; strong but a little slow.
move.leech-life.description: A bite that heals you by part of the damage it deals.
move.draining-kiss.description: A point-blank kiss that heals you by much of its damage.

move.wood-hammer.description: A huge hammer blow; you take a third of the damage it deals. Hold to charge.
move.drain-punch.description: A punch that heals you by half of its damage. Hold to charge.
move.giga-drain.description: An orb that drains life: heals you by half of its damage. Hold to charge.
move.thunderbolt.description: A fast bolt at range that staggers well. Hold to charge.
move.take-down.description: A strong tackle; you take a quarter of the damage it deals. Hold to charge.

move.phantom-force.description: Vanish and reappear, going through everything along a long line.
move.burning-jealousy.description: Flames of envy in a cone; burns whoever it reaches.
move.thunder.description: A huge bolt strikes all around you; very strong but slow to come out.
move.sucker-punch.description: Dart in with a low blow; more damage if the enemy is attacking.
move.u-turn.description: A rush that goes through the enemy and leaves you behind it.
move.lash-out.description: A furious swipe; stronger if your previous move missed.
move.swift.description: Stars that home in on the nearest enemy.
move.knock-off.description: A sharp blow that knocks the enemy back and staggers it hard.
move.sludge-bomb.description: A sludge bomb at range; poisons. Hold to charge.
move.grass-knot.description: A grass snare that trips: staggers hard. Hold to charge.
move.extrasensory.description: A psychic wave at range that staggers hard. Hold to charge.
move.calm-mind.description: Calm your mind: every hit 25% stronger and 20% less damage taken (7 s).
move.agility.description: Relax and lighten up: much more speed for 5 s.
move.hyper-voice.description: A deafening shout in a ring around you.
move.smog.description: A quick toxic puff at range; poisons.
move.night-shade.description: A quick shadow at range that staggers.
move.flame-charge.description: Rush forward wrapped in flames, hitting what you touch.
move.clear-smog.description: A ball of clear smog at range. Free.
move.fire-blast.description: A huge, slow blast of fire; burns. Hold to charge.
move.energy-ball.description: A ball of nature's energy at range. Hold to charge.
move.overheat.description: A devastating fireball; then you must wait 7 s to use it again.
move.flare-blitz.description: A flaming charge that burns; you take a third of the damage. Hold to charge.
move.poltergeist.description: Haunted objects strike in front of you, far and hard. Hold to charge.
move.solar-beam.description: Slow to gather, then a beam that goes through everything. Hold to charge.
move.psychic.description: A psychic wave at range. Hold to charge.
move.temper-flare.description: A burst of rage all around; double if your previous move missed.
move.acid-armor.description: Turn to liquid: take half the damage for 5 s.
move.minimize.description: Shrink down: more speed and a few crits for 4 s.
move.fire-spin.description: A fire vortex lingers in front of you and burns whoever stays in it.
move.mud-slap.description: Mud in the face: little damage but a long stagger.
move.headbutt.description: A running headbutt that staggers hard.
move.double-kick.description: Two kicks in a row in front of you.
move.thunder-punch.description: An electric punch that staggers well.
move.double-edge.description: A brutal tackle; you take a third of the damage. Hold to charge.
move.iron-head.description: A running steel headbutt that staggers hard. Hold to charge.
move.earth-power.description: The ground erupts in a straight line, through everyone. Hold to charge.
move.dig.description: Dig and burst out far ahead, hitting everything on the way. Hold to charge.
move.brick-break.description: A karate chop, quick for a heavy move. Hold to charge.
move.focus-punch.description: Focus for a long moment and land a colossal punch. Hold to charge.
move.scorching-sands.description: Scorching sand at range; burns. Hold to charge.
move.focus-energy.description: Focus up: half your hits are critical for 6 s.
move.belly-drum.description: Pay half your HP: your next 3 hits deal double (10 s).
move.iron-defense.description: Harden your body: take half the damage for 5 s.
move.rock-slide.description: Rocks fall in a cone in front of you and stagger.
move.ice-beam.description: An icy beam in a straight line, through everyone.
move.water-gun.description: A fast jet of water at range. Free.
move.bubble-beam.description: A burst of bubbles at range. Hold to charge.
move.surf.description: A wave around you hits everything close.
move.spark.description: A short electric tackle that staggers well.
move.dragon-claw.description: A quick slash with sharp claws.
move.dragon-pulse.description: A wave of draconic energy at range. Hold to charge.

challenge.abra.name: Abra's Dream
challenge.abra.subtitle: It sleeps, and the world moves
challenge.abra.lore: Abra dreamed of a light the eclipse could not drink. Follow its dream from room to room: its Essence waits at the end.
challenge.piplup.name: Piplup's Frozen Lake
challenge.piplup.subtitle: Under the ice, a glint
challenge.piplup.lore: Piplup once fell through the lake's ice and saw something shine below. Go down with it: the Essence sleeps under the frost.
challenge.shinx.name: Shinx's Storm
challenge.shinx.subtitle: One step per thunderclap
challenge.shinx.lore: When the eclipse put out the sun, Shinx kept a spark. The storm wants it back. Cross it and its Essence is yours.
challenge.axew.name: The Ravine of Fangs
challenge.axew.subtitle: A fang is earned by biting
challenge.axew.lore: Axew sharpens its fangs in a ravine no one goes down twice. There it swore to be strong. Keep its oath and take its Essence.
town.gacha.open: Pull one. If it's someone you already know, I give some back. Promise.
gacha.title: Lucky stall
gacha.intro: Each pull brings the first form of a line. If you already have it, I give some back.
gacha.text: One pull. The rare one is sure before the count runs out.
world.npc.oracle.evolve: Old souls know how to wait. Bring me Essence from the challenges and I will help yours grow.
world.npc.oracle.open: Let's see whose turn it is to grow.
evolve.title: Evolutions
evolve.text: Poké Coins and Essence of its line. Each challenge difficulty gives its own Essence.
evolve.hint: Enter evolves or awakens. Esc goes back.
evolve.shiny.text: The line's shiny look: it only changes the colours. Enter puts it on or takes it off.
evolve.none.text: The Pokémon you have can evolve or awaken here.
select.drops: Essence: Normal, Hard and Nightmare give their own. Easy gives none.
move.hyper-beam.description: A huge straight beam, then a long recharge. Costs stamina.
challenge.abra.floor.1: You close your eyes and open other ones. The floor is not the same.
challenge.abra.floor.2: Everything teleports: the doors, the echoes, you.
challenge.abra.floor.3: Someone else dreams here. Hoothoot does not blink.
challenge.abra.floor.4: A lamp in the dark. Lanturn guards the end of the dream.
challenge.abra.victory: Abra wakes. In your hand lies an Essence, warm as an idea.
challenge.piplup.floor.1: The ice creaks under your steps. Below, the water never froze.
challenge.piplup.floor.2: The cold bites. Piplup does not complain: it has its pride.
challenge.piplup.floor.3: The ice walls show reflections that are not yours.
challenge.piplup.floor.4: A hoard of frozen gems. Sableye has no plans to share.
challenge.piplup.victory: Piplup raises its beak. Under the broken ice, its Essence shines.
challenge.shinx.floor.1: The air crackles. Your hair stands on end.
challenge.shinx.floor.2: The rain falls sideways. Lightning marks the way.
challenge.shinx.floor.3: The storm roars. Shinx roars louder.
challenge.shinx.floor.4: In the eye of the storm, a burning poison. Salazzle is not afraid of lightning.
challenge.shinx.victory: The storm dies down. Shinx's spark shines brighter than ever.
challenge.axew.floor.1: The ravine walls are covered in fang marks.
challenge.axew.floor.2: Something follows you between the rocks. Show your teeth.
challenge.axew.floor.3: The path narrows. Here you bite or you fall.
challenge.axew.floor.4: An old tree closes the ravine. Trevenant does not let the weak pass.
challenge.axew.victory: Axew shows a new fang. Beside it, its Essence.
challenge.mimikyu.name: The Path of the Disguise
challenge.mimikyu.subtitle: What lies beneath
challenge.mimikyu.lore: A yellow rag sewn by hand, and someone underneath who does not want to be looked at. Mimikyu goes down into the crypt with you. It says it is for the materials.
challenge.mimikyu.floor.1: The shadows copy your shape. Some do it better than you.
challenge.mimikyu.floor.2: Scraps of cloth on the floor. Someone has tried a thousand disguises.
challenge.mimikyu.floor.3: The treasury. Something gleams in the dark, and watches.
challenge.mimikyu.floor.4: A broken mirror against the wall. Mimikyu walks past without looking.
challenge.mimikyu.victory: The disguise holds. What is inside smiles, for a moment.
challenge.zorua.name: The Path of the Reflection
challenge.zorua.subtitle: Nothing is what it seems
challenge.zorua.lore: Zorua has played at being others since the sun went out. Its pack crossed the Misty Forest and it was left behind. Go down with it: even the water wears its face.
challenge.zorua.floor.1: The cave's still water gives you back a face. It is not yours.
challenge.zorua.floor.2: A Phantump calls your name. It is not a Phantump.
challenge.zorua.floor.3: The rock breathes. Something the same colour as it is watching you.
challenge.zorua.floor.4: You no longer know which of the two is Zorua. It does.
challenge.zorua.victory: The illusion fades. The only real thing was the Essence in your hand.
challenge.litwick.name: The Path of the Flame
challenge.litwick.subtitle: One flame for every soul
challenge.litwick.lore: Litwick keeps the flame that guides the lost to the shore. Nobody asks it what it feeds on. Go down with it: some souls are still waiting for its light.
challenge.litwick.floor.1: Lit candles float on the black water. No one lit them.
challenge.litwick.floor.2: Every flame whispers a name. Litwick hears them all.
challenge.litwick.floor.3: A string hangs from the ceiling, and from it, a balloon that smiles.
challenge.litwick.floor.4: The wax drips upwards. Down here, everything burns backwards.
challenge.litwick.victory: The souls follow Litwick's flame upwards. They leave its Essence behind.
challenge.cubone.name: The Path of the Bone
challenge.cubone.subtitle: What is left of a mother
challenge.cubone.lore: Cubone fishes at the Black Lake and never looks at the water. It wears its mother's skull and never lets go of its bone. Go down with it: below, someone is humming.
challenge.cubone.floor.1: Old bones poke out of the mud. Cubone greets them one by one.
challenge.cubone.floor.2: A cry echoes between the graves. Cubone does not cry: it grips its bone.
challenge.cubone.floor.3: Something laughs among the reeds. It finds someone crying funny.
challenge.cubone.floor.4: A familiar voice calls you from the depths. It is not an echo.
challenge.cubone.victory: Cubone raises its bone. For a moment, the skull seems to smile.

story.mimikyu.title: The Path of the Disguise
story.mimikyu.phantump: Phantump: "That rag hides nothing anymore. It wears it because it wants to. That is awakening, and I did not do it."
story.mimikyu.1.title: I. The rag
story.mimikyu.1.before.1: A yellow rag, sewn by hand. The stitches are not those of someone who knew how to sew.
story.mimikyu.1.before.2: Mimikyu says it is coming down with you for the materials. It says so twice.
story.mimikyu.1.before.3: "If I break down there, don't look. I'll fix it tonight. I always fix it."
story.mimikyu.1.voice.arrive: Smile at the shadows. I always do, and they hardly ever attack me. Hardly.
story.mimikyu.1.voice.mid: No sun down here. Good. In the sun you can see the patches.
story.mimikyu.1.voice.lowHp: My neck bends when I'm scared. Don't look at it. It straightens out.
story.mimikyu.1.fragment.1.name: Eye button
story.mimikyu.1.fragment.1.text: A black button, sewn on and torn off many times. Someone was looking for the exact spot where an eye looks happy. They tried everywhere but their own.
story.mimikyu.1.fragment.2.name: Bent needle
story.mimikyu.1.fragment.2.text: A needle bent with use, still threaded with yellow. One sews at night, before a mirror, so nobody sees what is being sewn.
story.mimikyu.1.boss.3.title: The eyes that look
story.mimikyu.1.boss.3.pre.1: Sableye tilts its head. Its gem eyes never blink. Mimikyu steps behind you.
story.mimikyu.1.boss.3.post.1: The gems go dark. From inside the rag: "I hate eyes that shine."
story.mimikyu.1.boss.6.title: The one who forbids hiding
story.mimikyu.1.boss.6.pre.1: Aegislash: "Before this throne, nobody hides anything."
story.mimikyu.1.boss.6.post.1: Aegislash: "You keep your rag with more faith than I kept my door. Go on."
story.mimikyu.1.boss.7.title: What does not want to be seen
story.mimikyu.1.boss.7.pre.1: Something hangs from the ceiling in Mimikyu's shape. Too big. Too crooked.
story.mimikyu.1.boss.7.pre.2: Mimikyu: "That's not me. Don't look at it either."
story.mimikyu.1.boss.7.post.1: The shape comes apart into scraps. Mimikyu does not go near to pick them up.
story.mimikyu.1.after.1: The disguise's head hangs to one side. Mimikyu holds it up with something that is not a hand.
story.mimikyu.1.after.2: All night, before a broken mirror, it sews the neck. It does not ask you to leave. Nor to stay.
story.mimikyu.1.after.3: "You turned around before I asked. I won't forget it."
story.mimikyu.1.bond: I kept the best cloth on the stall for you. It's not for you. Well, it is.
story.mimikyu.2.title: II. The square
story.mimikyu.2.before.1: Before the Eclipse there was a square with sun, a swing and little ones who played until late.
story.mimikyu.2.before.2: Mimikyu went every afternoon. They hugged it. They hugged the rag, but the rag was it. Almost.
story.mimikyu.2.before.3: One afternoon the wind blew. The rag lifted for an instant. One of the little ones looked underneath.
story.mimikyu.2.before.4: "He never came back to the square. I did. Every afternoon. In case he came back."
story.mimikyu.2.voice.arrive: There was a song in the square. I can't get all of it. If you know it, hum it.
story.mimikyu.2.voice.mid: The shadows down here wear something over themselves too. I like them. A little.
story.mimikyu.2.voice.lowHp: If my head falls off, keep looking ahead. Promise me.
story.mimikyu.2.fragment.1.name: Swing ribbon
story.mimikyu.2.fragment.1.text: A red ribbon tied to a broken chain. In the square it was tied to the swing of whoever wanted to stay. Nobody tied it to Mimikyu's. It tied it itself, and waited.
story.mimikyu.2.fragment.2.name: Chalk slate
story.mimikyu.2.fragment.2.text: A chalk drawing: many little ones holding hands and, at the end of the row, a yellow one. Right there the chalk is rubbed out, as if someone had run a finger over it many times.
story.mimikyu.2.boss.3.title: The keeper of what shines
story.mimikyu.2.boss.3.pre.1: Sableye: "What pretty cloth. I bet there's something worth more underneath."
story.mimikyu.2.boss.3.post.1: Sableye drops a gem and crawls back to its corner. Mimikyu does not take it.
story.mimikyu.2.boss.6.title: The king's mirror
story.mimikyu.2.boss.6.pre.1: Aegislash: "My blade is a mirror. Look at yourself in it."
story.mimikyu.2.boss.6.pre.2: Mimikyu: "I'd rather look at you. You're uglier."
story.mimikyu.2.boss.6.post.1: Aegislash: "You did not look. But you did not run either. That is something."
story.mimikyu.2.boss.7.title: The wind that lifts the rag
story.mimikyu.2.boss.7.pre.1: Wind blows in a room with no windows. Mimikyu's great shape peels off the floor.
story.mimikyu.2.boss.7.pre.2: Mimikyu: "It blew like this that day. Stay by me. Please."
story.mimikyu.2.boss.7.post.1: The wind dies down. Mimikyu's rag stays where it is. It trembles, but it stays.
story.mimikyu.2.after.1: Mimikyu sews by the light of your candle. This time it does not turn the mirror around.
story.mimikyu.2.after.2: "The little one didn't fall ill from what he saw. He fell ill from fear. So did I. We've both been ill for a long time."
story.mimikyu.2.after.3: It ties a red ribbon to your bag. It says nothing. Neither do you. That's fine.
story.mimikyu.2.bond: Yesterday a Gastly told me my disguise was lovely. I embroidered it on a handkerchief so I won't forget.
story.mimikyu.3.title: III. What lies beneath
story.mimikyu.3.before.1: When the Eclipse came, everyone in the square turned to shadow. Not Mimikyu. It already was one.
story.mimikyu.3.before.2: It says it likes your shadow. That you can tell it came down with you too, without anyone asking it.
story.mimikyu.3.before.3: "Down there waits what I am when nobody loves me. Don't let it out. And if it gets out, don't leave."
story.mimikyu.3.voice.arrive: Nightmare, huh? I put on my good buttons.
story.mimikyu.3.voice.mid: You know the worst thing about hiding? In the end nobody looks for you. You do.
story.mimikyu.3.voice.lowHp: I've got the rag and I've got you. That'll do.
story.mimikyu.3.fragment.1.name: Scrap of the first cloth
story.mimikyu.3.fragment.1.text: A piece of the first disguise. It is more worn inside than out: from outside a few hugged it; from inside it hugged itself, every night.
story.mimikyu.3.fragment.2.name: List with nothing crossed out
story.mimikyu.3.fragment.2.text: Names embroidered on a handkerchief: those who looked and those who laughed. None is crossed out. Below, in smaller stitches: "I don't know how to hurt them. I don't want to learn."
story.mimikyu.3.boss.3.title: The greed of looking
story.mimikyu.3.boss.3.pre.1: Sableye: "Everyone wants to know what's underneath. So do I. More than anyone."
story.mimikyu.3.boss.3.post.1: Sableye: "Nobody... ever shows me..." And it sinks into its gems.
story.mimikyu.3.boss.6.title: The oath of hiding nothing
story.mimikyu.3.boss.6.pre.1: Aegislash: "I kept the throne for this. No rag, before the steel."
story.mimikyu.3.boss.6.pre.2: Mimikyu: "Not before the steel. Before my friend."
story.mimikyu.3.boss.6.post.1: Aegislash: "I never knew what my door kept. You do. Go on, and let them see you."
story.mimikyu.3.boss.7.title: What lies beneath
story.mimikyu.3.boss.7.pre.1: A black arm, far too long, reaches out from under the giant rag. It remembers every name on the list.
story.mimikyu.3.boss.7.pre.2: Mimikyu: "That's me if you leave. Stay. This time I want you to see me."
story.mimikyu.3.boss.7.post.1: The arm shrinks until it fits inside a rag. Mimikyu hugs it, the way you hug someone who was scared.
story.mimikyu.3.after.1: The disguise falls. For the first time, Mimikyu does not rush to pick it up.
story.mimikyu.3.after.2: What you saw is not told. It is kept, the way a lit candle is kept inside a closed hand.
story.mimikyu.3.after.3: "There. You've seen me. Are we still...? Okay. Okay. I'm going to sew something, my hands are shaking."
story.mimikyu.3.after.4: At the lake, Phantump looks up towards the crypt. Something has awakened without anyone asking it to.
story.mimikyu.3.bond: I don't straighten my head anymore when you come in. Well, sometimes. Out of habit.

challenge.cubone.floor.5: Black feathers on the grave mounds. Something big has been listening.
challenge.cubone.floor.6: A nest of bones on top of a stump. Mandibuzz does not hunt: it waits.
challenge.cubone.floor.7: Under the moon, something huge beats the ground with a bone. It does not cry.
challenge.cubone.2.floor.1: Water runs down the walls as if the cave were crying for someone.
challenge.cubone.2.floor.2: Marks of a bone on the stone, at the height of someone big.
challenge.cubone.2.floor.3: A red eye floats in the dark. Behind it there is no one, or there are many.
challenge.cubone.2.floor.4: Three notes, far away. Cubone stops dead.
challenge.cubone.2.floor.5: An empty nest of dry grass, still warm.
challenge.cubone.2.floor.6: Someone has left a cloth pouch hanging from a stalactite. It is empty.
challenge.cubone.2.floor.7: Grave mounds in a cave with no sky. A shadow with a bone hums among them.
challenge.cubone.3.floor.1: Stone steps, worn in the middle. Many have gone up. Few have come down.
challenge.cubone.3.floor.2: Small skulls in niches, one per step, all looking up.
challenge.cubone.3.floor.3: A door of blades. Bisharp does not let just anyone up.
challenge.cubone.3.floor.4: Full moonlight comes in through the arrow slits. Cubone does not look away.
challenge.cubone.3.floor.5: Snuffed candles in a row, as if someone had said goodbye to many people.
challenge.cubone.3.floor.6: A line of lights climbs the stair. Dusknoir walks them up one by one.
challenge.cubone.3.floor.7: The roof, open to the sky. The moon, with nothing in front of it. And grief, waiting.
story.cubone.title: The Path of the Bone
story.cubone.phantump: Phantump: "That bone hides no tears anymore. It carries a name, and a name weighs less than an absence. Now it can grow."
story.cubone.1.title: I. The helmet
story.cubone.1.before.1: The moon still rises over the Black Lake. It is the only thing the Eclipse did not take.
story.cubone.1.before.2: Cubone fishes off the dock and never looks at the water. The water reflects nothing anymore, and that is worse.
story.cubone.1.before.3: At night, inside the skull, there is something like a song. Cubone says it is the wind.
story.cubone.1.before.4: "I'm coming with you. No reason. It's just that down there you can't see the moon."
story.cubone.1.after.1: Back on the dock, Cubone pulls the rod out of the water. There was no bait. There never is.
story.cubone.1.after.2: "I don't fish to eat. I fish because if someone comes up from the bottom, I want to be here."
story.cubone.1.after.3: It lets you hold the rod for a while. It weighs little. Cubone holds it as if it weighed a lot.
story.cubone.1.voice.arrive: If you hear crying, it's the helmet. It sounds like that when the air gets in.
story.cubone.1.voice.mid: Mum used to say bones remember everything. This one won't be quiet.
story.cubone.1.voice.lowHp: The helmet takes hits. So did she.
story.cubone.1.fragment.1.name: Carved fishbone
story.cubone.1.fragment.1.text: A fishbone carved into a Magikarp, worn smooth from chewing. Someone carved it so a little one would stop crying while it waited.
story.cubone.1.fragment.2.name: Warm stone
story.cubone.1.fragment.2.text: A smooth stone from the lake bed, the size of a big hand. One side is warm: the side Cubone rests against its cheek when it thinks nobody is looking.
story.cubone.1.boss.3.title: The one who laughs at crying
story.cubone.1.boss.3.pre.1: Haunter peers out of the reeds, tongue out: "Is that sound crying? How funny. Cry some more."
story.cubone.1.boss.3.post.1: Haunter comes apart into smoke, still laughing. Cubone grips its bone and says nothing.
story.cubone.1.boss.6.title: She who hears crying
story.cubone.1.boss.6.pre.1: Great wings settle on the grave mounds. Mandibuzz tilts its head, listening.
story.cubone.1.boss.6.pre.2: Cubone, very quietly: "It comes when someone cries. It always comes. Don't make a sound."
story.cubone.1.boss.6.post.1: Mandibuzz tries to take off, but shadows do not fly. It stays, listening for a crying that has stopped.
story.cubone.1.boss.7.title: The one who stopped crying
story.cubone.1.boss.7.pre.1: A huge Marowak of bone and smoke beats the ground. With every blow the grave mounds shake.
story.cubone.1.boss.7.pre.2: Cubone: "It has her bone. It has my face. It has nobody."
story.cubone.1.boss.7.post.1: The smoke Marowak crouches down to Cubone's height. Then it is only smoke, and then nothing.
story.cubone.1.bond: I saved you a carved fishbone. It was mine. I don't chew it anymore. Almost.
story.cubone.2.title: II. The one who came back
story.cubone.2.before.1: When the Eclipse came, Cubone's mother went down into the caves to find light for the lake. She said she would be back before the moon.
story.cubone.2.before.2: Her skull came back, in other arms. Cubone put it on that night. It was too big. It is still too big.
story.cubone.2.before.3: Now they say that down below a shadow with her shape walks among the grave mounds. That it hums.
story.cubone.2.before.4: "If it's her, don't hit her. If it isn't her... don't either. Just in case."
story.cubone.2.after.1: It was not her. It was what Cubone kept of her, grown in the dark.
story.cubone.2.after.2: "I don't know if I'm glad. Is it all right not to know?" It is.
story.cubone.2.after.3: That night Cubone blows into the lullaby bone. The whole tune comes out for the first time. It does not play it again, in case it wears out.
story.cubone.2.voice.arrive: She used to sing a three-note lullaby. If you hear three notes, tell me.
story.cubone.2.voice.mid: If I see her, what do I say? I've been thinking for days. All I can come up with is "hello".
story.cubone.2.voice.lowHp: If I fall, don't take my helmet off. Underneath there's only a little one, and it's no use at all.
story.cubone.2.fragment.1.name: Lullaby bone
story.cubone.2.fragment.1.text: A small bone with three holes, one per note. Blown into, it plays a short lullaby. Someone blew it so many times that it shines.
story.cubone.2.fragment.2.name: Fishing knot
story.cubone.2.fragment.2.text: A knot only one person on the whole lake knew how to tie. Cubone has been trying to learn it for years. It almost gets it. Almost is what hurts most.
story.cubone.2.boss.3.title: The one who carries the dead inside
story.cubone.2.boss.3.pre.1: Dusclops opens its single eye. Inside, far down, something turns slowly, as if looking for the way out.
story.cubone.2.boss.3.post.1: The eye closes. Cubone, quietly: "She wasn't in there. I looked properly."
story.cubone.2.boss.6.title: The mother with the empty pouch
story.cubone.2.boss.6.pre.1: A shadow Kangaskhan comes very slowly, looking at Cubone. Her pouch is empty.
story.cubone.2.boss.6.pre.2: Kangaskhan: "Come. It isn't cold in here. Nobody gets lost in here."
story.cubone.2.boss.6.post.1: Kangaskhan stays sitting, hands over her pouch. Cubone looks back twice before it goes on.
story.cubone.2.boss.7.title: The shadow with her shape
story.cubone.2.boss.7.pre.1: Among the grave mounds a figure rises with a bone. It hums three notes. Then it turns round, and it is huge.
story.cubone.2.boss.7.pre.2: Cubone: "It isn't her. It isn't her. I know. Let me look at it a little longer."
story.cubone.2.boss.7.post.1: The figure comes apart. The three notes stay in the air a little longer than she does.
story.cubone.2.bond: I've learned the knot. Well, one like it. I tied it on your bag. Don't undo it.
story.cubone.3.title: III. What one wears
story.cubone.3.before.1: Beyond the crypt there is a tower with no roof. They say those with no one left to wait for climb it.
story.cubone.3.before.2: Cubone climbs. It does not say why. It holds its bone tight, the way you hold a hand in a crowd.
story.cubone.3.before.3: "There's a full moon tonight. It has her face. It always does. Tonight I'm going to look at it."
story.cubone.3.after.1: Up top there is no roof. Only the moon, with nothing in front of it. Cubone takes off its helmet to look. You do not see. It does not ask you to.
story.cubone.3.after.2: It cries. Not inside the bone: outside, in the open, where it can be heard. It sounds like a song.
story.cubone.3.after.3: When it puts the helmet back on, it fits. The bone hides no tears anymore: it carries a name.
story.cubone.3.after.4: At the lake, Phantump hears three notes coming down from the tower. For the first time since the Eclipse, the water trembles with something that is not fear.
story.cubone.3.voice.arrive: At the very top you can see the moon with nothing in front of it. I want to see it like that once.
story.cubone.3.voice.mid: I've worn the helmet so long I don't know if I wear it or it wears me.
story.cubone.3.voice.lowHp: She got tired too. And she kept going. So do I.
story.cubone.3.fragment.1.name: Footprints in the mud
story.cubone.3.fragment.1.text: Two sets of footprints, a big one and a small one, side by side. The big one stops halfway. The small one goes on alone, and then comes back.
story.cubone.3.fragment.2.name: Broken bone
story.cubone.3.fragment.2.text: Half a bone, broken on purpose. Someone has the other half. On the break, a mark made with care: "For when I'm gone."
story.cubone.3.boss.3.title: The one who guards the stair
story.cubone.3.boss.3.pre.1: Bisharp bars the way with its blades: "Those who wait for no one climb this tower. You are still waiting."
story.cubone.3.boss.3.post.1: Bisharp steps aside: "I was wrong. You are waiting for someone, but not for her to come back."
story.cubone.3.boss.6.title: The one who guides the dead
story.cubone.3.boss.6.pre.1: On the last landing, Dusknoir opens its hand. Behind it, a line of lights climbs slowly.
story.cubone.3.boss.6.pre.2: Dusknoir: "Here I walk with those who leave. Have you come to go, little one, or to say goodbye?"
story.cubone.3.boss.6.post.1: Dusknoir: "To say goodbye. Good. That is harder. Go up."
story.cubone.3.boss.7.title: The grief that will not let go
story.cubone.3.boss.7.pre.1: At the top, the smoke Marowak raises a burning bone. It dances among the roof's grave mounds, and every mound catches fire.
story.cubone.3.boss.7.pre.2: Cubone: "I've worn you a long time. That's enough. Come here."
story.cubone.3.boss.7.post.1: At the end Cubone does not strike it. It hugs it. The smoke Marowak goes very still, and rests.
story.cubone.3.bond: There's a moon tonight. Will you come to the dock? Not to fish. To look at it.

spell.story.cubone-mandibuzz.drop: Brave Bird Sign "Falling on the Crying"
spell.story.cubone-dusclops.last: Last Word "There Is No More Room"
spell.story.cubone-kangaskhan.survival: Embrace Sign "It Isn't Cold in Here"
spell.story.cubone-dusknoir.survival: Threshold Sign "It Is Not Your Time"
spell.story.cubone-wound.bloom: Bone Dance Sign "Fire Among the Graves"
spell.story.cubone-wound.survival: Hollow Skull Sign "So No One Hears"
challenge.litwick.floor.5: A child's footprints on the shore. They only go one way.
challenge.litwick.floor.6: A blue light sways in the grotto. Lanturn says it guides, too.
challenge.litwick.floor.7: A chandelier hangs in the cave, where there is no ceiling to hang anything from.
challenge.litwick.2.floor.1: A long, dusty carpet, and lamps lit on both sides.
challenge.litwick.2.floor.2: Faceless portraits on the walls. Someone has dusted them recently.
challenge.litwick.2.floor.3: The nursery. A doll follows you with its eyes.
challenge.litwick.2.floor.4: It smells of wax and cold soup. The table is laid for someone.
challenge.litwick.2.floor.5: A staircase climbs to a corridor where someone is singing.
challenge.litwick.2.floor.6: Every note lights a lamp. Mismagius lets none of them go out.
challenge.litwick.2.floor.7: The big house's dining hall. Over the long table, a chandelier that breathes.
challenge.litwick.3.floor.1: The sky is torn. Through the wound no light comes in: it goes out.
challenge.litwick.3.floor.2: The will-o'-wisps bend upwards, as if something were sipping them.
challenge.litwick.3.floor.3: Mud that moves by itself. Whatever falls in does not come out.
challenge.litwick.3.floor.4: Litwick burns lower than ever. It says it is on purpose.
challenge.litwick.3.floor.5: A lamp for the dead on a stone. Nobody tends it and it does not go out.
challenge.litwick.3.floor.6: Under the tear floats something that drinks light. Nihilego is thirsty.
challenge.litwick.3.floor.7: Every flame Litwick did not eat, all together, waiting for it.
story.litwick.title: The Path of the Flame
story.litwick.phantump: Phantump: "Now it gives light without charging for it. Light given from your own does not run out sooner. It runs out better."
story.litwick.1.title: I. The guiding candle
story.litwick.1.before.1: At the edge of the village there is a big house with every lamp lit. Nobody lives there. Nobody says who lights them.
story.litwick.1.before.2: Litwick keeps the flame that guides the lost to the shore. Nobody asks it what it feeds on.
story.litwick.1.before.3: "Come with me, but not so close. One more step back. There. That's right."
story.litwick.1.after.1: Back in the village, Litwick goes back to its place on the shore. Tonight the flame is smaller.
story.litwick.1.after.2: "I have to tell you something. When you're sad, I get hungry. I don't know why. I'm sorry."
story.litwick.1.after.3: You do not tell it to move away. Litwick stays exactly one step from you all night, coming no closer, going nowhere.
story.litwick.1.voice.arrive: It's cold down here. Not for me. I'm always warm. Don't ask where from.
story.litwick.1.voice.mid: The shadows follow me. They like the light. Everyone likes it, at first.
story.litwick.1.voice.lowHp: My flame is shrinking. If I came close to you I'd feel better. Don't let me.
story.litwick.1.fragment.1.name: Bitten candle stub
story.litwick.1.fragment.1.text: A candle stub with small tooth marks. Someone was so hungry for light they tried to eat it. Not Litwick: Litwick knows how to eat without it showing.
story.litwick.1.fragment.2.name: Odd glove
story.litwick.1.fragment.2.text: A child's woollen glove, the tip of the forefinger singed: the finger that reaches for a light. The other is still on a hand that got home cold.
story.litwick.1.boss.3.title: The one who takes children by the hand
story.litwick.1.boss.3.pre.1: Drifblim floats down, one long arm held out: "Are you lost? Give me your hand. I know where to go."
story.litwick.1.boss.3.post.1: Drifblim drifts off, deflating. Litwick, not looking at you: "I say that too. The bit about the hand."
story.litwick.1.boss.6.title: The other light
story.litwick.1.boss.6.pre.1: A blue light sways on the grotto's water. The small shadows swim towards it.
story.litwick.1.boss.6.pre.2: Litwick gets behind you: "That one says it guides too. Look at its teeth."
story.litwick.1.boss.6.post.1: Lanturn goes dark. Litwick, quietly: "I'm not like that. I'm not like that, am I?"
story.litwick.1.boss.7.title: The flames that are not its own
story.litwick.1.boss.7.pre.1: A huge chandelier hangs over the water. Every flame has a small face. All of them look at Litwick.
story.litwick.1.boss.7.pre.2: Litwick: "That's what I'll be if I don't stop eating. Get behind me. Don't let me get close."
story.litwick.1.boss.7.post.1: The flames slip out of the chandelier and rise. One stays by Litwick for a moment, as if it knew it.
story.litwick.1.bond: Today I guided a lost Wooper. I didn't charge much. Just a little. Just enough not to go out.
story.litwick.2.title: II. What a light costs
story.litwick.2.before.1: Before the Eclipse, the big house had owners, and a child who got lost in its corridors playing.
story.litwick.2.before.2: One night he got lost in the caves. He saw a pale light and reached out his hand. The light was Litwick.
story.litwick.2.before.3: It led him home. On the way it ate a little. Only a little. The child got home cold, and the cold never left him.
story.litwick.2.before.4: Since then every lamp in the big house burns. Litwick lights them, every night. Nobody has asked it to stop.
story.litwick.2.after.1: In the big house, every lamp goes out at once. There is no one left to light the way for.
story.litwick.2.after.2: "The child grew up. He was always cold. He lived a long time, they told me. I never went to see him."
story.litwick.2.after.3: Litwick puts its flame out for a moment, all the way, so you can see that in the dark it still sees you.
story.litwick.2.voice.arrive: I know this house. Here he asked me not to let go. I don't have hands. I said yes.
story.litwick.2.voice.mid: A candle lights the one it guides the same as the one it eats. That isn't written anywhere.
story.litwick.2.voice.lowHp: If I go out here, who lights the lamps? Nobody. Good. Better. No.
story.litwick.2.fragment.1.name: Lantern dark inside
story.litwick.2.fragment.1.text: A lantern with its glass whole and its wick intact. The wind did not put it out: it went out inside, like someone who no longer wants to guide anyone.
story.litwick.2.fragment.2.name: Guest book
story.litwick.2.fragment.2.text: The big house's guest book. The last page has a single name, written in a child's hand, very carefully. Beside it, a drop of wax.
story.litwick.2.boss.3.title: The toy nobody picked up
story.litwick.2.boss.3.pre.1: A rag doll gets up by itself in the nursery. Banette: "He left me here. He said he'd come back. A candle came instead."
story.litwick.2.boss.3.post.1: Banette falls still again. Litwick looks at it a long while. "It was his. I remember it in his other hand."
story.litwick.2.boss.6.title: She who sings in the corridor
story.litwick.2.boss.6.pre.1: A voice sings in the corridor of lamps. Each note lights another.
story.litwick.2.boss.6.pre.2: Mismagius: "This house lives on your light, little candle. If you leave, it will stay dark forever. Isn't that lovely?"
story.litwick.2.boss.6.post.1: The song breaks off halfway. The corridor's lamps flicker, as if unsure.
story.litwick.2.boss.7.title: The big house's lamp
story.litwick.2.boss.7.pre.1: The giant chandelier hangs over the long dining table. One of its flames has a child's face.
story.litwick.2.boss.7.pre.2: Litwick: "That one's his. I took it without meaning to. I've wanted to give it back for years."
story.litwick.2.boss.7.post.1: The flame with a child's face leaves the chandelier and goes out slowly, the way a candle goes out when someone blows and makes a wish.
story.litwick.2.bond: I've stopped lighting the lamps in the house. It makes me sad. But I don't eat the sadness. I keep it.
story.litwick.3.title: III. To burn without scorching
story.litwick.3.before.1: Something is still devouring the light below all the dungeons. Litwick can feel it. It is afraid of being like it.
story.litwick.3.before.2: "What if I'm a little piece of that? Something that eats other people's light to shine. Tell me if I am."
story.litwick.3.before.3: This time it goes down without asking you to keep away. It says it wants to try something. Not to be scared if it gets small.
story.litwick.3.after.1: Litwick goes out almost completely. Then, slowly, it comes back. This time the flame comes from inside.
story.litwick.3.after.2: It is not a candle anymore. It is a lamp with many arms, and on each arm burns a little piece of itself.
story.litwick.3.after.3: "Look. I haven't taken anything from you. You can come closer. You can come all the way."
story.litwick.3.after.4: At the lake, Phantump sees a new light in the big house. It is not frightening. For the first time in a long while, it is not frightening.
story.litwick.3.voice.arrive: Today I'll burn my own wax. It runs out sooner. I know.
story.litwick.3.voice.mid: I'm getting smaller. Look, but I give the same light. Don't I give the same light?
story.litwick.3.voice.lowHp: If I came close to you I'd heal. I'm not coming close. You move away, please.
story.litwick.3.fragment.1.name: Drop of wax
story.litwick.3.fragment.1.text: A drop of cold wax that fell downwards, the way real wax falls. Here everything burns backwards. Not this one: it belongs to someone who burned on their own.
story.litwick.3.fragment.2.name: Lamp for the dead
story.litwick.3.fragment.2.text: One of the lamps left beside those who are gone. It never goes out and nobody feeds it: it burns its own wick, slowly, asking nothing of anyone.
story.litwick.3.boss.3.title: The one who eats what it touches
story.litwick.3.boss.3.pre.1: Muk drags itself through the mud and everything it touches vanishes inside. Litwick: "That's how I see myself when I close my eyes."
story.litwick.3.boss.3.post.1: Muk sinks into the mud. Litwick: "I'm not like it. I'm not like it. But I had to look to know."
story.litwick.3.boss.6.title: What drinks the light
story.litwick.3.boss.6.pre.1: Under the tear in the sky floats something not from here. Litwick's flame bends towards it, like water towards a drain.
story.litwick.3.boss.6.pre.2: Litwick: "It's like me. But with no one to guide. Only hunger."
story.litwick.3.boss.6.post.1: Nihilego goes dark. Litwick's flame stands up straight again, on its own, with nothing holding it.
story.litwick.3.boss.7.title: The borrowed flames
story.litwick.3.boss.7.pre.1: The chandelier burns with every soul Litwick could have eaten and did not. What it would be. What it still could be.
story.litwick.3.boss.7.pre.2: Litwick: "I know you. You're my hunger. We're not eating today. Neither of us."
story.litwick.3.boss.7.post.1: The borrowed flames leave. The chandelier is left with a single small one that is its own. It is enough.
story.litwick.3.bond: Come closer. More. I don't charge you anymore. Well, a hug. I'll charge you a hug.
spell.story.litwick-drifblim.drop: Destiny Bond Sign "Give Me Your Hand"
spell.story.litwick-banette.survival: Rag Sign "He Said He'd Come Back"
challenge.zorua.floor.5: Your shadow walks a step behind you. Then a step ahead.
challenge.zorua.floor.6: On the wall, an enormous grin with nobody around it. Gengar copies what it sees.
challenge.zorua.floor.7: A puddle as big as a lake. At the bottom, a white fox is waiting for you.
challenge.zorua.2.floor.1: The mist draws paths that do not exist.
challenge.zorua.2.floor.2: A feather stuck in a trunk points one way. Go the other.
challenge.zorua.2.floor.3: Howls among the trees. A pack that does not look back.
challenge.zorua.2.floor.4: You have passed this tree before. It has the same claw marks. One more.
challenge.zorua.2.floor.5: A clearing with the grass flattened in a circle, as if someone had slept there waiting.
challenge.zorua.2.floor.6: From the branches, an archer who never misses. Decidueye sees through any illusion.
challenge.zorua.2.floor.7: The path comes back to the tree once more. This time someone is sitting in its roots.
challenge.zorua.3.floor.1: The mist is white and cold. It smells of someone who waited too long.
challenge.zorua.3.floor.2: Fox tracks in the mud, many of them, all going out. None coming in.
challenge.zorua.3.floor.3: Red eyes in the mist. Something hunts here, and it is in no hurry.
challenge.zorua.3.floor.4: Zorua walks ahead, being itself. The shadows do not know what to do with that.
challenge.zorua.3.floor.5: A mask on the ground, face up. You do not pick it up.
challenge.zorua.3.floor.6: A cracked stone complaining in a hundred and eight voices. Spiritomb does not forgive.
challenge.zorua.3.floor.7: In the middle of the white mist, the whole pack, backs turned. And one facing you.
story.zorua.title: The Path of the Reflection
story.zorua.phantump: Phantump: "It no longer dresses up as those who left. It has kept the one thing nobody ever took from it: itself."
story.zorua.1.title: I. The borrowed shape
story.zorua.1.before.1: At the village fountain, a quiet child looks into the water every afternoon. His reflection is a little fox.
story.zorua.1.before.2: Zorua has worn other faces since the sun went out. It says it is a game. It says so very quickly.
story.zorua.1.before.3: "Look! Now I'm you. Good, isn't it? You make my face and then we're even."
story.zorua.1.after.1: At the fountain, Zorua looks at itself in the water. For a moment it sees itself as it is, and looks away at once.
story.zorua.1.after.2: "Hey. Do you mind if I'm someone else sometimes? Just for a while. Then I come back. I always come back."
story.zorua.1.after.3: You tell it you do not mind. That afternoon, for the first time, the quiet child at the fountain laughs out loud.
story.zorua.1.voice.arrive: If you see two of me, the real one is the scared one. Easy.
story.zorua.1.voice.mid: Sometimes I put on someone's face and forget to take it off. Then it's hard to find mine.
story.zorua.1.voice.lowHp: Ow! All right, all right. No more games. It's me now. Look, it's me.
story.zorua.1.fragment.1.name: Feather in a trunk
story.zorua.1.fragment.1.text: A black and red feather stuck in a trunk, at a Zorua's height. Someone left it to mark the way. It points one way. The path went the other.
story.zorua.1.fragment.2.name: Puddle that does not match
story.zorua.1.fragment.2.text: A rain puddle. Whoever looks in sees their own face; Zorua sees another, always the same: someone big, long-haired, looking at it the way you look at one left behind.
story.zorua.1.boss.3.title: The one who changes colour too
story.zorua.1.boss.3.pre.1: The wall moves. Kecleon appears where nobody was: "You hide by being someone else too. Let's see who tires first."
story.zorua.1.boss.3.post.1: Kecleon turns the colour of the rock and is gone. Zorua: "Whoever tires first wins. I'm tired already."
story.zorua.1.boss.6.title: The shadow that copies you
story.zorua.1.boss.6.pre.1: Your shadow peels off the floor and stands up. It has an enormous grin.
story.zorua.1.boss.6.pre.2: Zorua: "Hey, that's cheating! Copying is my thing." Gengar: "Copying is the thing of everyone who is alone."
story.zorua.1.boss.6.post.1: Gengar sinks back to the floor and is only your shadow again. Zorua steps on it, just in case.
story.zorua.1.boss.7.title: The shape that stayed
story.zorua.1.boss.7.pre.1: A white-haired Zoroark comes out of the mist. It has many faces, and none of them is its own.
story.zorua.1.boss.7.pre.2: Zorua: "That's me if I'm alone a long time. A long, long time."
story.zorua.1.boss.7.post.1: The Zoroark's faces fall away one by one. Underneath there is nothing left, only mist.
story.zorua.1.bond: Today I wore your face to fetch berries and they gave me double. You have a kind face. Here, half.
story.zorua.2.title: II. The forest that does not answer
story.zorua.2.before.1: The night of the Eclipse, Zorua's pack crossed the Misty Forest by a path only they could see.
story.zorua.2.before.2: Zorua got scared and became a child, because children are not frightening. The pack walked right past it and did not know it.
story.zorua.2.before.3: Since then the path always comes back to the same tree. Zorua has walked it a thousand times, calling in voices that are not its own.
story.zorua.2.before.4: "If I call them in my own voice and they don't come, I won't be able to think they didn't hear me."
story.zorua.2.after.1: The path no longer comes back to the same tree. It was Zorua who came back, because it did not want to arrive anywhere without them.
story.zorua.2.after.2: "That night I became a child. If I'd stayed a fox, they'd have seen me. It was the fear. It wasn't them."
story.zorua.2.after.3: In the last clearing, an arrow grazes its ear and does not break the illusion. Zorua breaks it, alone, so you can see it.
story.zorua.2.voice.arrive: We've passed this tree already. No. Yes. This forest cheats, like me.
story.zorua.2.voice.mid: What if they didn't leave me? What if I hid so well they couldn't find me? That would be worse. Or better. I don't know.
story.zorua.2.voice.lowHp: If I fall, don't look for me with my face. Look for me with yours, that one I recognise.
story.zorua.2.fragment.1.name: Red tuft
story.zorua.2.fragment.1.text: A tuft of red hair caught on a bramble, at the height of someone big. It smells of home. Zorua has smelled it so often that now it smells more of Zorua.
story.zorua.2.fragment.2.name: Marked bark
story.zorua.2.fragment.2.text: Small claw marks on a tree, one for every time the path came round. There are so many that there is no bark left for the next one.
story.zorua.2.boss.3.title: The one who leads the pack
story.zorua.2.boss.3.pre.1: Mightyena howls and the forest's shadows fall in behind it: "A pack does not look back. If you look back, you stay."
story.zorua.2.boss.3.post.1: The shadows scatter. Zorua, very serious: "Mine did look back. I'm sure it did. I'm sure."
story.zorua.2.boss.6.title: The one who saw the pack pass
story.zorua.2.boss.6.pre.1: Decidueye: "Years ago I saw a pack pass, led by a false path. I let it pass. It was a kind illusion."
story.zorua.2.boss.6.pre.2: Zorua: "Was there a little one? With them? Tell me!"
story.zorua.2.boss.6.post.1: Decidueye: "There was a little one shaped like a child, beside them. Nobody looked at it. I did. I am sorry."
story.zorua.2.boss.7.title: The grudge of those left behind
story.zorua.2.boss.7.pre.1: The mist turns white. Out of it comes the white-haired Zoroark, wearing the face of every one of the pack.
story.zorua.2.boss.7.pre.2: Zorua: "Stop! Those faces aren't yours. Or mine. They're theirs, and we never asked for them."
story.zorua.2.boss.7.post.1: The white mist clears. For an instant the real forest shows: a straight path and, at its end, the village.
story.zorua.2.bond: I've stopped going round in circles in the forest. Now I go round the village. It's smaller. It ends sooner.
story.zorua.3.title: III. Without a mask
story.zorua.3.before.1: Beyond the swamp, the mist is white and smells of grudge. Those who waited too long for someone sleep there.
story.zorua.3.before.2: Zorua has gone days without wearing any face. Its own itches. It says that will pass.
story.zorua.3.before.3: "Today I'm going down as me. Just me. If that's not enough for you, tell me now, before we go in."
story.zorua.3.after.1: The white mist goes. Zorua stays in the clearing, being itself, and nobody goes anywhere.
story.zorua.3.after.2: When it looks into a puddle again, the reflection is big and long-haired. For the first time it is its own face.
story.zorua.3.after.3: "I don't need to look like anyone not to be alone anymore. Well: sometimes I'll wear yours. Because I like it."
story.zorua.3.after.4: At the lake, Phantump sees a big fox sitting at the fountain. For once, the water reflects what is there.
story.zorua.3.voice.arrive: Without a disguise everything sounds louder. The leaves, the footsteps. Your breathing. It's good to know you're here.
story.zorua.3.voice.mid: I'm remembering Mum's face. The real one, not the one I put on. It was prettier.
story.zorua.3.voice.lowHp: I'm not going to disguise myself so it won't hurt. It hurts the same. At least it hurts me.
story.zorua.3.fragment.1.name: Bark mask
story.zorua.3.fragment.1.text: A bark mask with a quiet child's face, carved with care and worn on the inside. Nobody wears it anymore. It lies on the ground, looking up.
story.zorua.3.fragment.2.name: Wayside stone
story.zorua.3.fragment.2.text: A stone from the path that runs straight to the village. Someone big scratched a claw mark on it for whoever came after. The mark points home.
story.zorua.3.boss.3.title: The hunter in the mist
story.zorua.3.boss.3.pre.1: Red eyes light up in the white mist. Houndoom: "I smell fox. Today you don't smell of anyone else. Strange."
story.zorua.3.boss.3.post.1: Houndoom moves aside and lies down in the mist: "Without a disguise you don't smell like prey. You smell like something else. Go."
story.zorua.3.boss.6.title: A hundred and eight grudges
story.zorua.3.boss.6.pre.1: A stone with a crack. From the crack come voices, many of them, all complaining at once about someone who never came back.
story.zorua.3.boss.6.pre.2: Zorua: "I used to complain like that too. From inside a stone you can't hear anyone calling you."
story.zorua.3.boss.6.post.1: The crack closes. Before it does, one of the voices, the smallest, says thank you.
story.zorua.3.boss.7.title: The white shape of the grudge
story.zorua.3.boss.7.pre.1: The white-mist Zoroark opens its arms. Around it, the whole pack, made of mist, turns its back on Zorua.
story.zorua.3.boss.7.pre.2: Zorua: "I know they aren't them. And I know you're me. Come on. Let's go home, it's this way."
story.zorua.3.boss.7.post.1: The mist pack turns towards it before it fades. No faces. Only the shape of someone turning round.
story.zorua.3.bond: In the village they asked me who I am. I told them my name. I was so embarrassed I put your face on. Sorry.
spell.story.zorua-kecleon.last: Last Word "Now You Don't See Me"
spell.story.zorua-spiritomb.moon: Hundred and Eight Sign "Choir of Complaints"
spell.story.zorua-wound.drop: Foul Play Sign "The One Left Behind"
spell.story.zorua-wound.bloom: Night Daze Sign "The Path That Loops"
